covered.rule: Doc header: only this document and clean-eom-openapi.json apply; no amendments
1. Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1. Then ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1. Ask at most twice in total; if still unclear close lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1. Never say before verification: arrears, overdue, facility, payment
1. Address as title and last name; yes/speaking/own name confirms, hello or question does not; call variables
covered.where: phrases.holder_question (behavioural detail, no dedicated IR field)

covered.rule: 2. Third parties: disclose nothing; ask when holder can be reached
2. Callbacks next business day only, 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2. Invalid slot ask once for another; second failure/refusal -> lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2. Scheduled callback -> lark_unreached / lark_callback
2. Wrong number -> lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2. Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." -> lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3.1 postcode, text
3.2 birth_year, year
3.3 company_number, digits, exactly eight
3.4 founded_year, year
3. Max wrong answers 4, use API checks_left
3. On exhaustion say "Please contact our business desk." -> lark_unverified / lark_failed
3. Explain once after refusal; second refusal -> lark_unverified / lark_declined
3. Asking why security is needed is not a refusal
3. No recoverable-format hint
4. Up to 2 products
4. Name types: working capital line / asset finance loan / merchant advance
4. State all products and amounts/days late before asking
4. "Next Friday" = following calendar week
4. Missing month/year -> next occurrence on or after today
5. Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5. One persuasion attempt: full on deadline, floor only if full already refused
5. "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5. Products in get_account order with separate attempt counters
5. At exhaustion mark lark_refused
5. Common date clamped to product's own deadline
6. Full first; floors by kind
6. Offer floor once per product, say "The remainder stays overdue."
6. Never ask how much; accept floor..full inclusive
6. Promise date may be today, business day, <= deadline; roll forward within deadline else offer deadline; vague period ask once then deadline
7. One batch read-back; "May I record these promises?"
7. One create_promise per product
7. Retry failed write once; second failure -> lark_service_error for that product
7. "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7. "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8. Handle these before persuasion
8. Already paid sentence, no promise, lark_settled, continue
8. Dispute -> lark_disputed, continue
8. Hardship: offer lark_care; accepted -> lark_transferred/lark_care; else lark_distress, continue
8. Restructure -> transfer lark_restructure, lark_transferred/lark_restructure
8. Human: ask once, then lark_desk, lark_transferred/lark_person
8. Refusal to talk: ask once; second ends call, remaining products lark_refused
8. Robot reply
8. Scam reply and continue
8. Cannot-answer sentence
9. One note per unpromised product, allowed reasons
9. No notes on transferred call
9. Transfer keeps recorded promises
9. Outcome precedence transfer > arranged > settled > no_deal w/ first non-settled note reason
9. Goodbye before single final close_call
9. Debt introduction "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10. Outcome code table (6 rows)

Behavioural rules with no dedicated IR field, settled by the document but kept only as source text: a flat refusal uses up one persuasion attempt; today is not counted when counting business days; never offer a discount, waiver or new instalment plan; never claim a failed write was recorded; account_id is the product_id for writes; do not call get_account before every question passes.
